'''Jayshon Korden''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Noble/Legends|noble]] house [[House Korden]] who became a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Korden fought for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in a conflict against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], but secretly carried out negotiations with his enemies, in an attempt to develop a negotiated peace. While he was unsuccessful at resolving the war by peaceful means, Korden's philosophies helped to shape the future of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Order.
